pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro mahāmatto pavāsaṃ gacchanto bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pāhesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.7: athakho so mahāmatto ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā mayā pahite dūte nāgacchissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.11: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa mahāmattassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.12: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.13: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.5: addasā kho āyasmā ānando senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto tāni cīvarāni cīvaravaṃse bhaṇḍikābaddhāni ṭhitāni disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.6: kassimāni āvuso cīvarāni cīvaravaṃse bhaṇḍikābaddhāni tiṭṭhantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.9: athakho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa yathānikkhittaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.11: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū accekacīvarāni paṭiggahetvā cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.12: athakho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.13: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū accekacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetvā cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.16: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā accekacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetvā cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmessanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.17: netaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.18: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.19.1: dasāhānāgataṃ kattikatemāsipuṇṇamaṃ bhikkhuno paneva accekacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ paṭiggahetvā yāvacīvarakālasamayaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.20: tato ce uttariṃ nikkhipeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.6: senāya vā gantukāmo hoti pavāsaṃ vā gantukāmo hoti gilāno vā hoti gabbhinī vā hoti assaddhassa vā saddhā uppannā hoti appasannassa vā pasādo uppanno hoti. so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya āgacchantu bhaddantā vassāvāsikaṃ dassāmīti. etaṃ accekacīvaraṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.7: accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ paṭiggahetvā yāvacīvarakālasamayaṃ nikkhipitabbanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.13: anatthate kaṭhine vassānassa pacchimaṃ divasaṃ atikkāmeti nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.14: atthate kaṭhine kaṭhinuddhāradivasaṃ atikkāmeti nissaggiyaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.15: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.18: idaṃ me bhante accekacīvaraṃ cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.23.1: accekacīvare accekacīvarasaññī cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.24: accekacīvare vematiko cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.25: accekacīvare anaccekacīvarasaññī cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.32: avilutte viluttasaññī cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.33: nissaggiyaṃ cīvaraṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñjati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.38: antosamayaṃ adhiṭṭheti vikappeti vissajjeti nassati vinassati dayhati acchinditvā gaṇhāti vissāsaṃ gaṇhāti
